diametric_formula: radius=N/8, plus N8 radius .7; goals fixed opposite unperturbed starts
horizon: max(2000,800*N), explicit axis4b prescription; Config.max_steps=10000 is a generic default, not an alternate N schedule
free_area: Physical workspace area minus rectangles; unbounded plane => infinity, density0
closest_approach: Shared normalized straight-path progress t in [0,1]
midpoint_crowding: Mean count of other path midpoints within 3r
